_comment: PoC YAML key tree for schema-aware completion + hover (UI spec §1.1). Content mirrors docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-aitmproxy-poc-language-design.md §'Document structure', §'Step types', §'Matcher / extractor DSL', §'Success / assertion model' and its four worked examples. Node = { type, description, required?, enum?, keys?, items?, one_of_keys?, $ref? }. `keys` is the child key map of a `map`; `items` is the element node of a `list`; `$ref` is `#/$defs/<name>`. Completion walks the YAML nesting: key position -> the enclosing node's `keys`; after `key:` -> that node's `enum` (or true/false for `boolean`). If the builder's validation poc-schema ships, regenerate this from it.

severity.description: How serious the finding is; maps to Severity.

description.description: What the finding is (no fix prose).

default.description: Default value; may be a DSL expression wrapped in {{ }}, evaluated once at run start.

required.description: Whether the caller must supply a value (default false).

steps.description: Ordered steps; each entry has exactly one step key.

http.description: Send an HTTP request through the proxy's guarded client.

body.description: Request body (templated); use raw for full control.

raw.description: Full raw HTTP text with placeholders (nuclei RAW mode).

browser.description: Drive the embedded browser with one action.

expr.description: JavaScript to run; bind or assert its value (eval).

script.description: Rhai escape hatch using the plugin-system Rhai API, plus vars.get/vars.set.

name.description: Optional label; success can reference the step's verdict by this name.

script.description: Rhai source; may `return pass` or `return fail`.

l4.description: Run a native L4 verb and assert on the received `packet` (scapy-style, human-readable). `op: send_recv` injects a stimulus and binds the reply as the `packet` source (e.g. `field: tcp.flags`).

op.description: Allowed values for `op` in a `l4:` step.

success.description: What 'triggered' means: an assertion tree evaluated after all steps. A bare matcher, or a list of matchers, is also allowed.

any.description: True when at least one assertion holds.

matcher.description: A matcher or assertion over a response, the page, or a step's verdict.

dsl.description: DSL expression over status_code, body, all_headers, content_length and extracted vars (dsl).

expr.description: JavaScript to evaluate in the page (browser-eval).

part.description: Which part of the response to match (default body).

condition.description: How a matcher's own values combine.

name.description: Label for the matcher, referenceable from success.

extractor.description: Extracts a value from a response or the page; a named extractor binds a variable.

name.description: Binds a variable for later steps.

from.description: Which part of the response to extract from.

kval.description: Header or cookie key, dashes as underscores (kval).

protocol_step.description: A protocol namespace's native `<ns>:` step (extensibility seam). Its body keys are the namespace's verb vocabulary — host-fn names from the Rhai `<ns>.*` vocabulary, or the one-shot subset of them that fits a single assertion step (e.g. l4's wire verbs) — and a sibling `extract:` reads a field from one of the step's named sources. Concrete `<ns>` step entries under steps[].items.keys are generated from each protocol's NamespaceCatalog; this is the shared shape they take. The l4 namespace is the first consumer (Task 6): see steps[].items.keys.l4.

op.description: The verb to run; one of the namespace's host-fn names.

protocol_extractor.description: A `<ns>:` step's sibling extractor: reads `field` from a named source the step produced (e.g. `type: packet, field: tcp.flags`).

name.description: Binds a variable for later steps and success.

type.description: The source name the step produced (e.g. packet, echo).

field.description: Dotted field path into the named source (e.g. tcp.flags).
